title: STAT3-orchestrated gene expression signatures and tumor microenvironment in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma uncovered by single-cell sequencing.
authors: Pang, Shilian; Chen, Yurao; Zheng, Zemao; Wang, Luoshai; Chen, Ronghuai; He, Ming; Zhao, Xiang; Yao, Juan; Jin, Liyan
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. General subjects
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单细胞测序和bulk RNA-seq分析ESCC中STAT3调控网络及肿瘤微环境，虽涉及转录因子STAT3与DNA结合调控LHPP，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且未聚焦三维互作建模，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The progression of Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma (ESCC) can be dissected with greater precision using multi-omics and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) compared to traditional methodologies. These advanced approaches enable a comprehensive understanding of cellular heterogeneity and molecular dynamics, offering higher resolution insights into cancer development. Moreover, analyzing transcription factor regulatory networks provides innovative avenues for identifying cancer biomarkers and therapeutic targets, driving new perspectives in cancer research. OBJECTIVE: To explore the molecular mechanisms and cellular dynamics of ESCC. METHODS: Utilizing bulk-RNA-seq and single-cell transcriptomics, our study identify major cell types, transcriptomic gene and function changes during ESCC progression. Validation experiments in clinical sample tissues and ESCC cell lines to confirm core regulation factor in ESCC. RESULTS: We identified six major cell types in the ESCC scRNA-seq dataset and revealed profound shifts in cellular composition and transcriptional profiles. Notably, STAT3 was found to be a core regulator in ESCC and negatively regulated LHPP expression at promoter sites. Elevated STAT3 and reduced LHPP expression were consistently observed in patient samples, highlighting their inverse relationship in ESCC pathogenesis. CONCLUSION: This study integrates bulk-seq and scRNA-seq data to reveal the pivotal role of STAT3 in ESCC. STAT3 negatively regulates LHPP expression, driving tumor progression. These findings underscore the therapeutic potential of targeting STAT3 in ESCC. KEY WORDS: ESCC, single-cell transcriptomics, ESCC microenvironment, STAT3.
abstract_zh: 背景：相较于传统方法，利用多组学与单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）可更精确地解析食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）的进展过程。这些先进方法能够全面理解细胞异质性和分子动力学，为癌症发展提供更高分辨率见解。此外，分析转录因子调控网络为识别癌症生物标志物和治疗靶点提供了创新途径，推动了癌症研究的新视角。目的：探讨ESCC的分子机制和细胞动力学。方法：利用批量RNA测序（bulk-RNA-seq）和单细胞转录组学，本研究识别了ESCC进展过程中的主要细胞类型、转录组基因及功能变化。在临床样本组织和ESCC细胞系中进行验证实验，以确认ESCC中的核心调控因子。结果：我们在ESCC scRNA-seq数据集中识别了六种主要细胞类型，并揭示了细胞组成和转录谱的深刻变化。值得注意的是，STAT3被发现是ESCC的核心调控因子，并在启动子位点负调控LHPP表达。在患者样本中一致观察到STAT3升高和LHPP表达降低，突显了它们在ESCC发病机制中的反向关系。结论：本研究整合bulk-seq和scRNA-seq数据，揭示了STAT3在ESCC中的关键作用。STAT3负调控LHPP表达，驱动肿瘤进展。这些发现强调了靶向STAT3在ESCC中的治疗潜力。关键词：ESCC，单细胞转录组学，ESCC微环境，STAT3。
